Terms of use (read 2026-10-24, last updated 7 September 2026) clause 4.5: "refrain from accessing the Platform or extracting its content by automated means (bots, scrapers, crawlers)" and "from using Platform content to train, fine-tune or operate machine-learning models"; section 9: "All acts of extraction, data mining, scraping and similar acts ... are strictly prohibited." Against that, the API itself is documented as public, unauthenticated and "intended for AI agents/assistants" (https://jobgether.com/llms.txt, https://jobgether.com/openapi.json, https://jobgether.com/astroapi/ai/jobs/docs). robots.txt Allows /astroapi/ai/jobs.json (with a query) and Disallows /*?* elsewhere, sets Crawl-delay: 2 and Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. The terms page returned HTTP 403 to this honest user agent, so the clause text was read through a separate fetch tool, not from a committed capture. Rate limit header: ratelimit-policy "ai-jobs";q=60;w=60. The listing carries NO description; no detail endpoint is documented. No personal data: company names and job titles only.
